items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Do you remember any of the guys like Bridges or John Hardy? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, John Hardy.

ctx.x: Yeah, that might have been it, but later on--

Further on, there's always been the comments that the Texas and Oklahoma south-west bands had a distinctive or characteristic sound, especially the tenor players. Do you remember any of the guys like Bridges or John Hardy?
